record.paper_title: Research Problems on Relations Between Nijenhuis Geometry and Integrable Systems
record.context_brief: Projectively invariant conditions of weight five
record.original_question: Find a differential condition on skew-symmetric tensors g^{ij} of projective weight 5 that remains invariant under projective changes of a flat connection, with the goal of producing nontrivial fourth-order geometric Poisson brackets.

evidence.quote: Problem 6.2. Find differential condition on skew-symmetric tensors gij of weight 5 which is invariant under projective change of the connection leaving the connection flat.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $M$ be a smooth manifold of dimension $n \ge 2$ equipped with a torsion-free affine connection $\nabla$ with Christoffel symbols $\Gamma^k_{ij}$. Two such connections $\nabla$ and $\widetilde{\nabla}$ are said to be projectively equivalent if there exists a 1-form $\omega_i$ such that
$$\widetilde{\Gamma}^k_{ij} = \Gamma^k_{ij} + \delta^k_i\,\omega_j + \delta^k_j\,\omega_i.$$
A projective change of $\nabla$ is a change to a projectively equivalent connection $\widetilde{\nabla}$. A connection is flat if its curvature tensor vanishes; the projective class of a flat connection is the set of all connections projectively equivalent to it (which need not themselves be flat).

A contravariant tensor field $g^{ij}(x)$ is said to have projective weight $w \in \mathbb{R}$ if, under a change of local coordinates with Jacobian $J = \det(\partial \tilde x/\partial x)$, its components transform as a tensor density of weight $w$, i.e.
$$\widetilde{g}^{ij} = J^{-w}\, \frac{\partial \tilde x^i}{\partial x^a}\,\frac{\partial \tilde x^j}{\partial x^b}\, g^{ab}.$$

Problem. Find a nontrivial differential condition (i.e., a system of partial differential equations expressed in terms of $g^{ij}$ and the connection coefficients $\Gamma^k_{ij}$) on skew-symmetric contravariant 2-tensor fields $g^{ij} = -g^{ji}$ of projective weight $5$ that
(i) is invariant under any projective change of the connection $\nabla$ that preserves flatness of the projective class, and
(ii) is suitable for serving as the defining condition of the leading coefficient of a nontrivial fourth-order geometric (homogeneous, differential-geometric) Poisson bracket on the loop space of $M$.
artifact.category_tag: Projectively invariant differential conditions and geometric Poisson brackets
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit research problem in a 2024 list of open questions on Nijenhuis geometry and integrable systems. No publication located in a web search resolves the existence of such a projectively invariant weight-5 differential condition on skew-symmetric tensors, and no follow-up work claiming a solution was found.
